title: Gallformers import — taxonomy batch
description: Taxonomic acts a Source states: names, placements, synonymies, splits. Applied before the gall batch from the same Source. Never contains Galls. Never changes plant taxa (except the rare gall-forming plant). Written for every Source: empty taxa and acts mean the Source states no taxonomic acts.

taxa.description: Every taxon the acts mention, declared once. Empty when acts is empty.

acts.description: Empty means the Source states no taxonomic acts (or, on a retraction notice, that it carries none). With mode replace, that clears acts previously attributed to the Source.

act.description: Dispatches on kind (if/then rather than oneOf, so validation errors point at the offending field).

status_as_written.description: Optional. The Source's own status words for this act, as written: 'syn. nov.' (this Source makes the synonymy), 'stat. rev.', 'incorrect spelling', 'nomen dubium', 'combination by Smith (1900)'. Kept for review and later parsing; not a controlled value.

name_act.description: The taxon exists with this name and rank, with this authorship. Combined with taxa[].new, the Source's description of a new taxon or new combination.

as_written.description: Exactly as written, e.g. '(Ashmead, 1881)'. Not parsed.

placement_act.description: The taxon sits under this parent. A newer placement than the current one is a move. A new intermediate rank is a name act plus placements.

synonymy_act.description: name is a synonym of accepted. A lump is several synonymy acts. A recombination is a placement, the new combination's name act, and the old combination as a synonym.

split_act.description: The taxon was divided into these taxa. States the division only; assigning existing records to the daughters is curator work.

common_name_act.description: A common name of the organism, as written (e.g. 'Poplar vagabond aphid'). Common names of Galls are alias Facts in the gall batch.
